sources.summary: Promotion: an exhibition during this year's Maison&Objet furniture fair in Paris is set to demonstrate the continued relevance of Hanji, a thousand-year-old Korean papermaking technique. Located within the Paris-Nord Villepinte exhibition centre, the exhibition aims to demonstrate contemporary potential uses for Hanji, Korea's traditional handmade paper.
